verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' API docs have a dedicated Webhook Callbacks page. It describes subscribing to real-time event notifications (e.g. registering a callback for invoice.create), a verification handshake at registration, and HMAC signature verification using the verification code as the secret. The docs also state candidly that delivery timing is not guaranteed and can range from seconds to minutes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook delivery works in practice.
